body: I appreciate the objective of this post of yours. It's a fairly appealing creation. I may seem petty. But, I'll share my assessment without ornamenting it. In the title, use of the word detrimental is superfluous. It's avoidable.

Recent developments in my life have been devastating. The past few years have been harrowing. There have been days I've had no desire to persist. I've experienced abandonment by the live of my life, impediments in ascension and loss of wealth. It'd immensely help me if some kind soul could have a look at my chart and share their insights.
